note_text:
CC: thick painful nails plus new heel pain on ambulation

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to painful plantar callus. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with painful plantar callus. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.

Procedure: Paring of single hyperkeratotic lesion performed (LT and RT modifiers documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
